title: Better PoweredBy logo
body:
The current powered by logo is not very nice: it is blurred, not retina ready and doesn't scale well.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5570853/18004093/204363bc-6b92-11e6-9ec1-e590f3d66e62.png)

comments.body: Is it blurry because of using a non retina PNG? SVG could be a solution

> Is it blurry because of using a non retina PNG? SVG could be a solution

So first it's blurry indeed, but mostly it's not the current/latest version of the logo /o\

I kept the same PNG format for now. Maybe base64/inlined SVG is working as well -> I think we went for PNG to target old IE browsers (https://css-tricks.com/probably-dont-base64-svg/#article-header-id-1).
I think that we can now use SVG everywhere now, don't you agree @Shipow ?
This should be safe yes, if anyone wants to try it
gogo SVG, there is one available on our design index
